title: Professional Tip: Preventing Trap Siphonage in Drainage Vents
description: A reliable drainage system depends on atmospheric venting to balance air pressure inside wastewater piping. When wastewater flows rapidly down an unvented drain line, it creates a negative pressure vacuum behind the water flow. This vacuum can siphon the water seal completely out of the P-trap. Without a intact water seal, toxic sewer gases can freely migrate into the living space. Professional installers always maintain required code distances between the trap arm and the vent connection. Ensuring correct trap geometry and proper venting protects indoor air quality and prevents sewer gas backflow.
